source: City of Chicago Open Data Portal
note: Columns marked 'derived' are added by the ETL pipeline and do not exist in the raw CSV.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each crime record, assigned by the Chicago open data portal.

columns.name: case_number
columns.description: The Chicago Police Department RD (Records Division) number, which is unique to each incident.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Date and time the incident occurred. Stored without timezone (UTC-equivalent local time).

columns.name: block
columns.description: The partially redacted address where the incident occurred, showing only the block level.

columns.name: iucr
columns.description: Illinois Uniform Crime Reporting code. A four-digit code directly linked to the primary type and description.

columns.name: primary_type
columns.description: The primary category of the crime (e.g. THEFT, BATTERY, ASSAULT). Maps to the first two digits of the IUCR code.

columns.name: description
columns.description: A more specific description of the crime within the primary type.

columns.name: location_description
columns.description: Description of the location where the incident occurred.

columns.name: arrest
columns.description: Whether an arrest was made in connection with this incident.

columns.name: domestic
columns.description: Whether the incident was coded as a domestic violence case under the Illinois Domestic Violence Act.

columns.name: beat
columns.description: The beat where the incident occurred. A beat is the smallest police geographic area.

columns.name: district
columns.description: The police district where the incident occurred. Chicago has 25 police districts.

columns.name: ward
columns.description: The ward (city council division) where the incident occurred. Chicago has 50 wards.

columns.name: community_area
columns.description: The community area where the incident occurred. Chicago is divided into 77 community areas.

columns.name: fbi_code
columns.description: The crime classification code per the FBI's National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS).

columns.name: x_coordinate
columns.description: X coordinate of the location in the State Plane Illinois East NAD 1983 projection.

columns.name: y_coordinate
columns.description: Y coordinate of the location in the State Plane Illinois East NAD 1983 projection.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Latitude of the incident location in decimal degrees (WGS 84).

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Longitude of the incident location in decimal degrees (WGS 84).

columns.name: location
columns.description: Raw location string combining latitude and longitude in the format (lat, lon).

columns.name: year
columns.description: Year the incident occurred. Denormalised column — duplicates the year component of 'date' for fast GROUP BY queries.

columns.name: updated_on
columns.description: Date and time the record was last updated in the City of Chicago data portal.

columns.name: day_of_week
columns.description: Name of the day of the week derived from the 'date' column by the ETL pipeline. Used to avoid EXTRACT() on every query.

columns.name: month
columns.description: Month number (1–12) derived from the 'date' column by the ETL pipeline.

columns.name: hour
columns.description: Hour of the day (0–23) derived from the 'date' column by the ETL pipeline.

columns.name: inserted_at
columns.description: Audit column. Timestamp of when this row was written to the database. Set automatically by PostgreSQL DEFAULT NOW().
